nodes.name: Cathodic electrodeposition of (oxy)hydroxides
nodes.procedure: The catalysts are synthesized as thin films via cathodic electroprecipitation/electrodeposition at room temperature in 1 M KOH electrolyte to directly access the hydrated oxide or (oxy)hydroxide phases that would otherwise form in situ at the surface of oxide-based catalysts synthesized at high temperature. Film masses were 8-12 μg cm⁻² for all films except the thin FeO_xH_y which was 0.5 to 1.0 μg cm⁻².
nodes.source_text: The catalysts are synthesized as thin films (with loading of ∼10 μg cm⁻²) via electrodeposition at room temperature... Film masses were 8-12 μg cm⁻² for all films except the thin FeO_xH_y which was 0.5 to 1.0 μg cm⁻².

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS used to measure compositions of the (oxy)hydroxide catalysts on Au substrates, with similar compositions on Pt listed in Table S1.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The compositions listed in the Figures were measured by XPS on Au substrates unless otherwise noted. Compositions measured on Pt for the mixed-metal catalysts are similar and are listed in Table S1.

nodes.characterization_summary: QCM monitors catalyst film mass in situ with loadings of 8-12 μg cm⁻² for most films and 0.5-1.0 μg cm⁻² for thin FeO_xH_y films; Ni- and Co-based catalysts stable while FeO_xH_y dissolves substantially and MnO_xH_y slightly at high current densities.
nodes.evidence_snippet: A quartz-crystal microbalance was used to monitor mass in situ... Film masses were 8-12 μg cm⁻² for all films except the thin FeO_xH_y which was 0.5 to 1.0 μg cm⁻². Exact masses can be found in Table S1.

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ electrical conductivity measurement shows FeO_xH_y and MnO_xH_y have the lowest conductivity, becoming measurable above ~400 mV overpotential while Ni- and Co-based catalysts are conductive.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Interdigitated electrodes are used to measure the electrical conductivity in situ of each catalyst and determine whether the measured activities are affected by poor electronic transport.
